id: 01_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200w Unboxing and First Use
title: 手持激光焊机：开箱安装与首次使用
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/01_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200w Unboxing and First Use.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/01_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200w Unboxing and First Use/src.py

points.S7: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实训车间里，身旁是一台带轮子的手持激光焊机，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a bright university workshop beside a wheeled handheld laser welder unit with a coiled cable and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：手持激光焊机从开箱到上手。
overlay: 手持激光焊机：开箱安装与首次使用

shots.scene: 纸箱、插头、焊枪、扳手四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cardboard box, a power plug, a handheld welding gun and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 开箱、安装、首次使用、日常维护。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在托盘上的大纸箱前，两眼放光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of a large cardboard crate on a wooden pallet in a workshop, looking excited.
shots.narration: 实验室新到了一台手持激光焊机。

shots.scene: 阿杰拆开箱子，拎起电源线就往墙上插座走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has opened the crate and walks toward a wall socket carrying a thick power cable.
shots.narration: 阿杰拆开箱子，就想插电试一试。

shots.scene: 老李拦住阿杰，一手拿空白说明书，一手拿防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the young male student, holding a blank manual in one hand and a pair of laser safety goggles in the other.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：先培训，再按步骤来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们一步一步装好、用好它。

shots.scene: 老李掀开纸箱顶盖，再从侧面拉开箱体
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the lid off a large cardboard crate, then pulls the side walls apart.
shots.narration: 先掀开顶盖，再从侧面拆下外箱。

shots.scene: 一张物品清单，上面是各部件的小图标，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist sheet with small pictograms of parts, each with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 对照物品清单，逐件清点。

shots.scene: 耐热手套、空白说明书、棉签排在桌上
shots.prompt_en: Heat-resistant welding gloves, a blank instruction booklet, a blank quick guide and a small pack of cotton swabs laid out on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 随箱有耐热手套、说明书和棉签。

shots.scene: 一副绿色镜片的激光防护眼镜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a pair of wraparound laser safety goggles with tinted green lenses resting on a soft case. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一副专用的激光防护眼镜。

shots.scene: 焊接嘴、清洗嘴、切割嘴和一小盒圆形镜片排成一行
shots.prompt_en: A row of copper nozzles of different shapes and a small clear box of round lens protectors on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接、清洗、切割，各有专用喷嘴。

shots.scene: 老李先把焊接头从泡沫里取出，再拿掉泡沫
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carefully lifts a handheld welding head out of the foam packing first, then removes the foam blocks.
shots.narration: 先取出焊接头，再拿掉泡沫。

shots.scene: 长线缆一圈圈绕在主机侧面的挂架上
shots.prompt_en: A long cable is wound neatly in loops on the side hanger of a wheeled laser welder unit. No people.
shots.narration: 长线缆绕好，挂在主机侧面。

shots.scene: 主机正面示意图：急停按钮、状态灯、钥匙孔和几个接口
shots.prompt_en: A front view diagram of a laser welder unit: a red emergency stop button, a status light, a key slot and several round ports, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 正面有急停按钮、钥匙孔和接口。

shots.scene: 主机顶部的触摸屏和侧面的进气接头
shots.prompt_en: Top of the laser welder unit with a blank touchscreen, and a gas inlet fitting on its side. No people.
shots.narration: 上方是触摸屏，侧面是保护气入口。

shots.scene: 主机背面示意图：电源开关、送丝机接口、电源线
shots.prompt_en: A rear view diagram of the laser welder unit: a rocker power switch, a round feeder port and a thick power cable, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 背面是电源开关和送丝机接口。

shots.scene: 一台小型送丝机，侧面有丝盘，顶部有两个按键
shots.prompt_en: A small wire feeder box with a wire spool on its side and two buttons and a light on its top panel. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机有送丝键、回抽键和丝盘。

shots.scene: 主机放在平整地面上，前后留出空隙，箭头示意距离
shots.prompt_en: The laser welder unit stands on a flat floor with clear space in front and behind it, shown by two double-headed arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 主机放平，前后各留出间隙。

shots.scene: 一只脚踩下脚轮的刹车片
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a foot pressing down the brake tab on a caster wheel of the unit.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮都要锁住。

shots.scene: 散热口被纸箱挡住的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a machine whose air vents are blocked by stacked boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 散热口不能挡，周围别堆杂物。

shots.scene: 一卷蓝色气管，带一个空白编号标签
shots.prompt_en: A coil of blue plastic gas tube with a small blank number tag on it. No people.
shots.narration: 接保护气，用随附的气管。

shots.scene: 气管一端插进主机侧面的进气接头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand pushing the end of a blue gas tube into the gas inlet fitting on the side of the unit.
shots.narration: 一端插进主机的保护气入口。

shots.scene: 气管另一端接到气瓶减压器下方的流量计
shots.prompt_en: The other end of the blue tube is connected to a flow meter under the regulator of a gas cylinder. The cylinder is chained upright to a wall bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 另一端接气瓶或制气机。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角扳手组装一个黑色焊枪支架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer assembles a black metal welding head cradle on a table with a small hex key.
shots.narration: 先把焊枪支架组装好。

shots.scene: 焊接头稳稳搁在支架上
shots.prompt_en: A handheld welding head rests securely in the black cradle on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接头不用时，放回支架上。

shots.scene: 老李把一根带夹子的线缆插头插进主机接口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the connector of a cable with a clamp into a round port on the front of the unit.
shots.narration: 再把工件感应线插进对应接口。

shots.scene: 主机铭牌放大，旁边是电源、回路、接地三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A large blank rating plate on the unit, next to three icons: an AC plug, a single dedicated circuit breaker and a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 接电前，先看清铭牌上的电源要求。

shots.scene: 配电箱里一个单独的断路器亮起，接地符号闪烁
shots.prompt_en: Inside an open distribution box, one dedicated circuit breaker is highlighted and a ground symbol glows beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 建议用独立回路，电源必须接地。

shots.scene: 老李拿着电工工具在配电箱前接线，背后是空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing insulated gloves wires a power cable at a distribution box; a blank certificate card hangs on his chest.
shots.narration: 需要硬接线，交给专业电工来做。

shots.scene: 圆形插头对准主机插座，大针朝上
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a round power connector being aligned with the socket on the unit, an arrow showing the correct orientation. No people.
shots.narration: 圆形插头对准方向，插紧到位。

shots.scene: 手指触碰红色急停按钮，按钮处于弹起状态
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a finger touching a red emergency stop button that is popped up in its released position.
shots.narration: 开机前，确认急停按钮已经松开。

shots.scene: 钥匙插进主机正面的钥匙孔
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small key being inserted into the key slot on the front panel of the unit.
shots.narration: 把钥匙插进专用钥匙孔。

shots.scene: 手指拨动背面的翘板电源开关，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: A finger flips the rocker power switch on the back of the unit; the touchscreen on top lights up blank.
shots.narration: 打开背面电源开关，设备启动。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上一排空白语言按钮，手指点选
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps one of several blank buttons on a touchscreen showing a row of flag icons. No people.
shots.narration: 首次开机，先选语言和单位。

shots.scene: 小研用手机扫屏幕上的方形码图标，手机上播放视频
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student scans a square code pattern on the touchscreen with her phone; a video play icon appears on the phone.
shots.narration: 扫屏幕上的码，看完安全培训视频。

shots.scene: 笔记本电脑网页上一个空白输入框和一把钥匙图标
shots.prompt_en: A laptop showing a blank web form with one empty input box and a key icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看完后输入序列号，生成解锁密码。

shots.scene: 小研在触摸屏数字键盘上输入，屏幕出现开锁图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student types on a blank number keypad on the touchscreen; an unlocked padlock icon appears.
shots.narration: 输入密码，设备才能解锁使用。

shots.scene: 触摸屏设置页里一个数值框被放大镜圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank settings page on the touchscreen with one value box circled by a magnifying glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在系统设置里查看焦距参考值。

shots.scene: 焊接头前端的刻度管特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the graduated tube at the front of a handheld welding head, with blank tick marks. No people.
shots.narration: 再对照焊接头上的刻度管。

shots.scene: 手松开卡扣，轻轻推拉刻度管
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand opening a small fastener and gently sliding the graduated tube on the welding head.
shots.narration: 不一致，就松开卡扣推拉调整。

shots.scene: 三个图标：焊缝打勾，清洗和切割图标旁是送丝机打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a weld seam with a wire feeder and a green check, a cleaning spark icon and a cutting icon each with the wire feeder crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机只在焊接时用。

shots.scene: 送丝机放在主机左侧，脚轮刹车踩下
shots.prompt_en: The small wire feeder sits on the left side of the main unit; its caster brakes are pressed down. No people.
shots.narration: 放在主机左侧，脚轮同样锁住。

shots.scene: 老李把连接线插进主机背面，拧紧金属外圈
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs a round connector into the back of the main unit and screws the metal ring tight.
shots.narration: 用连接线接主机，拧紧金属外圈。

shots.scene: 老李打开送丝机侧门，松开送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the side door of the wire feeder and loosens the red tension levers on the drive unit.
shots.narration: 打开送丝机，松开送丝驱动。

shots.scene: 一个送丝轮特写，外侧刻着空白规格标记，旁边是焊丝盘
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small metal drive roll with a blank size marking on its outer face, next to a wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝轮外侧的规格，要和焊丝一致。

shots.scene: 拆下螺丝，装上送丝轮，再拧回螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands removing a screw, fitting a drive roll onto its shaft and screwing it back in.
shots.narration: 拆下螺丝，装上轮子，再装回螺丝。

shots.scene: 另一对送丝轮放在驱动上方的收纳位
shots.prompt_en: A spare pair of drive rolls is placed in a storage slot above the drive unit. No people.
shots.narration: 另一对轮子收在上方备用。

shots.scene: 手合上右侧压紧器，松开侧面螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand closing the right tension lever and loosening a small screw on the side of the drive unit.
shots.narration: 先合上右侧压紧器，松开螺丝。

shots.scene: 送丝管不带卡扣的一端插入送丝机
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands inserting the plain end of a black wire feeding tube into the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 把不带卡扣的一端插进送丝机。

shots.scene: 拧紧螺丝，再打开压紧器
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand tightening the screw and then opening the tension lever again.
shots.narration: 顶到位后拧紧，再打开压紧器。

shots.scene: 拧下丝盘轴上的盖子，取下套筒
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands unscrewing a cap from the spool shaft and sliding off a sleeve.
shots.narration: 拧下盖子，取下套筒。

shots.scene: 丝盘上的孔对准轴上的销钉
shots.prompt_en: A wire spool is aligned so that a hole in its hub matches a small pin on the shaft, shown with two green circles. No people.
shots.narration: 丝盘的孔对准销钉装上去。

shots.scene: 两个丝盘方向图：丝从底部出打勾，从上方出打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams side by side: a spool with the wire leaving from the bottom marked with a green check, and one with the wire leaving from the top crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 注意方向，丝要从盘底出来。

shots.scene: 手捏住丝头，旁边松手散丝的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand firmly pinches the loose end of the welding wire; beside it an icon of a spool unravelling is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 取丝头时捏紧，一松手就会散开。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手用剪钳剪掉弯曲的丝头
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand uses wire cutters to trim the bent end of a welding wire.
shots.narration: 剪掉弯曲的丝头，小心扎手。

shots.scene: 焊丝穿过两个送丝轮，进入送丝管，箭头示意路径
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the welding wire passing between two drive rolls and into the wire feeding tube, shown with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 穿过送丝轮，送进送丝管。

shots.scene: 合上压紧器，旋转旋钮，旁边一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand closing the tension levers and turning a red knob, next to a blank table with rows and columns.
shots.narration: 合上压紧器，按表格调好张力。

shots.scene: 手打开卡扣，把送丝管滑到焊接头前端
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands opening a fastener and sliding the wire feeding tube onto the tip of the handheld welding head.
shots.narration: 把送丝管装到焊接头前端。

shots.scene: 焊丝从焊接嘴侧面的小槽里伸出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding wire coming out through a small groove on the copper welding nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 焊丝要从焊接嘴的槽里出来。

shots.scene: 焊接头手柄背面的几个按键和指示灯
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the back of a welding head handle with two small arrow buttons, a slide switch and a status light, all unlabeled. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接头上也有送丝、回抽键。

shots.scene: 固定送丝管，焊接头放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeding tube is clipped along the cable and the welding head is placed back in its cradle. No people.
shots.narration: 固定好送丝管，放回支架。

shots.scene: 送丝管末端的铜色送丝嘴特写，带空白规格标记
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a small copper wire feeding nozzle with a blank size marking at the end of the wire feeding tube. No people.
shots.narration: 出厂送丝嘴，对应细规格焊丝。

shots.scene: 手指按住送丝机的送丝键，丝盘匀速转动
shots.prompt_en: A finger holds down the feed button on the wire feeder while the spool turns steadily, shown with a curved arrow.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，丝盘匀速转动。

shots.scene: 焊丝刚露出喷嘴，手指松开；回抽箭头
shots.prompt_en: The wire tip just appears at the nozzle and the finger releases the button; a small backward arrow shows the retract option. No people.
shots.narration: 丝一露头就停，长了就回抽。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前观看安全培训视频，屏幕是播放图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches a safety training video on a computer; the screen shows only a play icon and a laser warning pictogram.
shots.narration: 正式用之前，先看激光焊接安全培训。

shots.scene: 五个蓝色圆形防护图标：护目镜、面罩、口罩、手套、防护服
shots.prompt_en: Five blue round safety pictograms in a row: goggles, a welding face shield, a dust mask, gloves and protective coveralls. No people.
shots.narration: 防护用品一件都不能少。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿上防护服和围裙，戴手套和面罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on flame-resistant coveralls, a leather apron, heat-resistant gloves and a welding face shield over laser safety goggles.
shots.narration: 穿防护服、系围裙，皮肤别露在外面。

shots.scene: 车间排风扇转动，气流箭头
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan in a workshop wall spins, with airflow arrows moving out of the room. No people.
shots.narration: 工作间要保持通风良好。

shots.scene: 气瓶减压器下装着透明流量计
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a transparent flow meter mounted below the regulator on an upright gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶上先装好流量计。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上一个出光开关处于关闭状态，被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A touchscreen with a toggle switch icon in the off position, circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 确认出光开关是关着的。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手打开气瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand slowly opens the valve on top of an upright, chained gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 慢慢打开气瓶阀门。

shots.scene: 手握焊接头按住握持键和扳机，流量计浮子升起
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds the welding head pressing the grip button and trigger, while the float in the flow meter rises. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 按住握持键和扳机通气，调好流量。

shots.scene: 工件放在金属台上，感应线夹子夹住工件
shots.prompt_en: A metal workpiece sits on a metal bench vise; the clamp of the sensing cable is attached to the workpiece. No people.
shots.narration: 工件放金属台上，夹好感应线。

shots.scene: 夹子夹在焊接头刻度管上的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a cable clamp attached to the graduated tube of a welding head, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁把夹子夹在焊接头刻度管上。

shots.scene: 焊丝尖端与一个红色光点重合
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the tip of a welding wire meeting a small red aiming dot on a metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 调焊丝，让丝尖对准红光点。

shots.scene: 两个分屏：红点偏在焊丝一侧、红点模糊，各打问号
shots.prompt_en: Split view: on the left a red dot beside the wire tip, on the right a faint blurred dot, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 红光偏了或看不清，要先校准。

shots.scene: 手指把焊接头上的送丝开关拨到开
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a thumb sliding the wire feeding switch on the welding head to the on position.
shots.narration: 打开焊接头上的自动送丝开关。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上选择焊接模式，几排空白按钮
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps a blank mode button on a touchscreen with several rows of blank option buttons. No people.
shots.narration: 屏幕上选标准模式里的焊接。

shots.scene: 三个按钮组：材料、板厚、丝径
shots.prompt_en: Three groups of blank buttons on a touchscreen with small icons of a metal sheet, a thickness gauge and a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 再选材料、板厚和焊丝直径。

shots.scene: 屏幕弹窗出现戴面罩的头像图标和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A pop-up window on the touchscreen shows a face shield icon and a goggles icon with a green confirm bar. No people.
shots.narration: 启用出光时，屏幕提醒戴好防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰全副防护，把喷嘴对准两块对齐工件的起点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear with face shield aims the welding nozzle at the start of the joint between two aligned metal plates.
shots.narration: 对齐工件，喷嘴对准起点。

shots.scene: 阿杰按住握持键和扳机，焊点发出强光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the grip button and trigger; a bright glow appears at the weld point behind a laser safety curtain.
shots.narration: 按住握持键和扳机，开始焊接。

shots.scene: 示意图：焊缝两端先点两个点，再连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a seam: two dots at both ends first, then a continuous line between them, shown in two steps. No people.
shots.narration: 先点焊两端固定，再焊整条缝。

shots.scene: 焊接头被轻轻往后推的箭头，手稳稳引导
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the welding head with a small backward push arrow at the tip and a hand steadily guiding it forward. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接时有反推力，稳住引导方向。

shots.scene: 焊接头往下压的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a welding head being pressed down hard onto the workpiece, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别往下压焊接头，免得粘丝。

shots.scene: 刚焊好的工件和焊接嘴发出红热光，旁边高温图标
shots.prompt_en: A freshly welded metal part and the copper nozzle glow orange-hot, with a hot surface warning icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 焊完的工件和焊接头还很烫。

shots.scene: 空手去摸工件的图标打叉，屏幕上两个开关被关闭
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bare hand reaching for a hot part crossed out in red, next to a touchscreen with two toggles switched off. No people.
shots.narration: 别空手去碰，关掉送丝和出光。

shots.scene: 手指关掉主机电源开关
shots.prompt_en: A finger switches off the rocker power switch on the back of the unit.
shots.narration: 激光清洗，先关机换嘴。

shots.scene: 拆下送丝管和焊接嘴，换上清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands removing the wire feeding tube and the copper welding nozzle, then fitting a straight cleaning nozzle.
shots.narration: 拆下送丝管和焊接嘴，换清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 开机，屏幕选清洗，启用出光后点确认
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps a cleaning icon on the touchscreen, then a green confirm bar. No people.
shots.narration: 开机选清洗，启用出光并确认。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴好防护，焊接头平行于焊缝，在金属表面清洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear holds the welding head parallel to a weld seam and cleans the metal surface; a laser safety curtain stands behind.
shots.narration: 焊接头平行焊缝，按住按键清洗。

shots.scene: 触摸屏设置页的数值框，旁边一个记事本
shots.prompt_en: A blank value box on the touchscreen settings page next to a small notepad and pencil. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切割：先记下焦距参考值。

shots.scene: 关机后换上细长的切割嘴，刻度对齐
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands fitting a slim cutting tip onto the welding head and lining up the graduated tube marks.
shots.narration: 关机换切割嘴，刻度对准参考值。

shots.scene: 气瓶上换装带两块压力表的减压阀
shots.prompt_en: An upright chained gas cylinder fitted with a pressure-reducing regulator that has two blank round gauges. No people.
shots.narration: 气源换用带减压阀的压力表。

shots.scene: 两个分屏：完整红点打勾，残缺红点打叉
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a clear round red dot with a green check, and a broken partial red dot with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开机看红光是否清晰完整。

shots.scene: 喷嘴口被烧黑的图标，旁边一个扳手
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a nozzle tip scorched black, next to a small wrench icon for calibration. No people.
shots.narration: 不完整先校准，否则会烧坏喷嘴。

shots.scene: 手转动减压阀手柄，压力表指针移动
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand turning the regulator knob while the needle on a blank gauge moves. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 气压按说明书要求调好。

shots.scene: 屏幕上选切割、材料、厚度，再点出光
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger taps a cutting icon, a material icon and a thickness button on a touchscreen. No people.
shots.narration: 选切割、材料和厚度，启用出光。

shots.scene: 阿杰在挡光帘后切割金属板，火花四溅
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in full protective gear cuts a metal plate behind a laser safety curtain; sparks fly onto a clear metal floor area.
shots.narration: 确认后切割，火花飞溅要当心。

shots.scene: 两个铜色送丝嘴并排，一小一大
shots.prompt_en: Two copper wire feeding nozzles side by side, one with a small hole and one with a larger hole, with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝嘴要按焊丝直径来换。

shots.scene: 送丝管带卡扣的一端，可拧下的嘴
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the fastener end of the wire feeding tube with a screw-on nozzle being removed by hand.
shots.narration: 带卡扣的一端，装着可换的嘴。

shots.scene: 焊接火花变弱、功率表下降的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a weak small spark next to a power bar dropping down. No people.
shots.narration: 功率下降、火花变弱，查保护镜片。

shots.scene: 小研戴上蓝色无尘手套，在干净的台面前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on blue lint-free gloves at a clean, tidy bench.
shots.narration: 在洁净处操作，戴无尘手套。

shots.scene: 小研用无尘布擦拭焊接头外表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the outside of the welding head with a lint-free cloth.
shots.narration: 先用无尘布把焊接头擦干净。

shots.scene: 拆开焊接头顶盖，取出圆形镜片座
shots.prompt_en: Close view of blue-gloved hands removing a small top cover from the welding head and pulling out a round lens holder.
shots.narration: 拆开顶盖，取出保护镜片。

shots.scene: 棉签蘸酒精轻擦镜片
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a cotton swab dipped in alcohol gently wiping a round lens protector held by blue-gloved fingers.
shots.narration: 有污渍，用棉签蘸酒精擦净。

shots.scene: 烧出黑点的镜片和一片新镜片，箭头替换
shots.prompt_en: A round lens with a burnt dark spot and a new clean lens in a clear box, with a replace arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 烧伤或擦不净，就换新镜片。

shots.scene: 手指直接按在镜面上的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bare fingertip touching a lens surface, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 镜面不能用手指或工具去碰。

shots.scene: 撕掉镜片两面的保护膜，按方向压回
shots.prompt_en: Close view of blue-gloved hands peeling thin protective film off both sides of the lens and pressing the holder back into the welding head.
shots.narration: 撕掉两面保护膜，按方向压到位。

shots.scene: 红点落在焊丝一侧，左右箭头
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a red dot sitting beside a welding wire tip, with left and right arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 红光偏在焊丝一侧，做左右校准。

shots.scene: 老李站在触摸屏前，屏幕显示一个锁形图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands at the touchscreen, which shows a padlock icon and a blank keypad.
shots.narration: 这一步在管理员设置里，由老李来做。

shots.scene: 手指点触屏上的左右箭头，红点移到焊丝上
shots.prompt_en: A finger taps left and right arrow buttons on the touchscreen while the red dot moves onto the wire tip. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 点左右箭头，把红光移到焊丝上。

shots.scene: 切割嘴剖面示意：光束打到内壁，被挡住反射
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of a slim cutting nozzle with a beam hitting the inner wall and bouncing, marked with a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 切割嘴挡光反光，再查上下偏移。

shots.scene: 手用小内六角扳手慢慢拧焊接头上的螺丝，红点变清晰
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand slowly turning a tiny hex key in a hole on the welding head while a red dot becomes sharp and clear.
shots.narration: 用内六角扳手慢慢调，直到红光清晰。

shots.scene: 焊接嘴和清洗嘴两个大孔喷嘴，旁边绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A welding nozzle and a cleaning nozzle with wide openings, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接嘴和清洗嘴孔大，一般不用调。

shots.scene: 细丝盘箭头指向粗丝盘，下方三个小图标
shots.prompt_en: A thin wire spool with an arrow pointing to a thicker wire spool, and below them three small icons: a drive roll, a nozzle and a spool. No people.
shots.narration: 换粗一号的焊丝，配件要跟着换。

shots.scene: 打开压紧器，丝盘倒转把丝退出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands opening the tension levers and turning the spool backward to pull the wire out of the drive unit.
shots.narration: 打开压紧器，倒转丝盘把丝退出。

shots.scene: 丝头弯起，卡进丝盘边缘的小孔
shots.prompt_en: Close view of fingers bending the wire end and tucking it into a small hole on the rim of the spool.
shots.narration: 丝头弯起来，卡进丝盘的小孔。

shots.scene: 换上新的送丝轮，外侧规格放大显示
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a new drive roll being fitted, with a magnified circle showing a blank size marking on its outer face.
shots.narration: 换上与新丝径一致的送丝轮。

shots.scene: 送丝管末端换成大号送丝嘴
shots.prompt_en: Close view of hands screwing a larger copper nozzle onto the end of the wire feeding tube.
shots.narration: 送丝嘴也换成大号的。

shots.scene: 装上新丝盘，剪丝头，穿丝
shots.prompt_en: Hands mount a new wire spool, trim the wire end with cutters and thread it into the drive unit.
shots.narration: 装新丝盘，剪丝头，再穿丝。

shots.scene: 调好张力，按住送丝键，丝从喷嘴伸出
shots.prompt_en: A finger holds the feed button on the wire feeder until the wire tip appears out of the nozzle on the welding head. No people besides the hand.
shots.narration: 调好张力，按住送丝键直到出丝。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研、阿杰上设备培训课，阿杰在空白考核卷上作答
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives an equipment training session; the young male student writes on a blank test sheet while the female graduate student listens.
shots.narration: 上机前要先培训、考核、获得授权。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白操作规程，旁边是预约登记本
shots.prompt_en: A blank operating procedure poster on the wall beside the laser welder, and a blank booking logbook on a small desk. No people.
shots.narration: 按操作规程使用，提前预约登记。

shots.scene: 老李站在阿杰身边指导第一次操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands beside the young male student and guides his first practice at the laser welder.
shots.narration: 第一次上手，要有老师在旁指导。

shots.scene: 焊接头射出一束看不见的光，用虚线表示，旁边警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A handheld welding head with an invisible beam drawn as a dashed line and a laser warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接激光看不见，能量却很高。

shots.scene: 焊接工位四周围着挡光屏障，门口贴着激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A welding booth surrounded by laser safety barrier curtains; a laser warning sign is posted on the closed door. No people.
shots.narration: 要在有屏障的激光受控区里用。

shots.scene: 门外一个学生被拦下，门上挂着禁止入内标志
shots.prompt_en: A student is stopped outside the closed door of the laser area, which shows a no entry sign and a laser warning sign. The security officer gestures him to wait.
shots.narration: 无关人员不得进入，门要关好。

shots.scene: 光束打在亮金属板上被反射出去的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of a dashed beam hitting a shiny metal plate and reflecting off at an angle toward the room. No people.
shots.narration: 光亮金属会把激光反射出去。

shots.scene: 受控区里每个人都戴着对应波长的防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Inside the laser area, the young male student and the facility engineer both wear tinted laser safety goggles.
shots.narration: 区里每个人都要戴对应的防护镜。

shots.scene: 配电箱里漏电保护开关和接地线的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a residual current circuit breaker with a test button and a green-yellow ground wire inside a distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 要有漏电保护，设备可靠接地。

shots.scene: 大功率设备插在多孔插线板上的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a big machine plug in a cheap multi-socket power strip with tangled wires, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉乱接，不用插线板接大设备。

shots.scene: 老李戴绝缘手套检修，旁边空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing insulated gloves checks a cable connection, a blank certificate badge on his chest.
shots.narration: 接线检修，由持证电工完成。

shots.scene: 气瓶直立，用链条固定在墙边支架上
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder stands upright, secured with a chain to a wall bracket, with a valve cap nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶要直立放稳，用链条固定。

shots.scene: 气瓶远离焊接区，中间画出距离箭头
shots.prompt_en: A chained gas cylinder placed away from the welding booth, with a double-headed arrow between them and a spark icon on the booth side. No people.
shots.narration: 远离火花和热源，接头不能漏气。

shots.scene: 狭小房间里气体云团和一个头晕的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a small closed room filling with a pale gas cloud and a dizzy person pictogram, next to an open window icon. No people.
shots.narration: 保护气积聚会让人窒息，要通风。

shots.scene: 手拧紧气瓶阀门
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a hand turning the cylinder valve closed.
shots.narration: 用完关紧瓶阀。

shots.scene: 焊接点上方升起灰色烟尘
shots.prompt_en: Grey fumes rise above a glowing weld point on a metal plate. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接和清洗，会产生烟尘和有害气体。

shots.scene: 焊接台上方的局部排风罩把烟吸走
shots.prompt_en: A local exhaust hood with a flexible arm above the welding bench draws the fumes away, shown by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 开启局部排风或烟尘净化装置。

shots.scene: 镀锌板、涂漆板图标，旁边口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a galvanized metal sheet and a painted metal sheet with warning marks, next to a dust mask icon. No people.
shots.narration: 镀层、涂层工件烟气更多，要戴口罩。

shots.scene: 火花落到纸箱上冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of hot sparks landing on a cardboard box that starts to smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 火花会引燃周围的可燃物。

shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱、抹布和溶剂瓶搬离工位
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries cardboard boxes, rags and a closed solvent bottle away from the welding booth.
shots.narration: 开工前，清走纸箱、溶剂等易燃物。

shots.scene: 工位旁挂着灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher and a fire blanket pouch hang on the wall next to the welding booth, with a fire extinguisher sign above. No people.
shots.narration: 旁边备好灭火器，人人会用。

shots.scene: 王老师在登记本上签字，一张空白动火审批单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank permit form at a desk.
shots.narration: 动火作业，按学校规定审批。

shots.section_title: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管
shots.scene: 关掉电源开关，拔下钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the power switch and pulls the key out of the key slot on the unit.
shots.narration: 维护、换嘴前，关机断电拔钥匙。
overlay: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管

shots.section_title: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管
shots.scene: 老李把钥匙放进上锁的小柜，信封上画着锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts the key into a small locked key cabinet and seals an envelope marked with a padlock icon.
shots.narration: 钥匙和管理员密码，由负责人保管。

shots.section_title: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管
shots.scene: 出厂默认密码图标被划掉，换成新的锁
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a default password card crossed out with a red X, replaced by a new padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 默认密码要及时修改。

shots.section_title: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管
shots.scene: 小瓶酒精和棉签，旁边火焰图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A small closed bottle of alcohol and cotton swabs, next to a flame icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精易燃，少量取用，远离火源。

shots.section_title: 维护前断电，钥匙密码专人管
shots.scene: 小研在空白维护记录本上写字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes in a blank maintenance logbook on the bench.
shots.narration: 每次维护都要做好记录。

shots.scene: 急停按钮被按下，焊接头放下
shots.prompt_en: A hand slaps the red emergency stop button on the unit while the welding head is set down.
shots.narration: 出现异常，立即按下急停。

shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰捂眼去医院，眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student accompanies the young male student, who covers one eye, toward a clinic sign with an eye icon.
shots.narration: 怀疑眼睛被照到，马上去医院检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手放在流动冷水下冲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his hand under cool running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 烫伤先用流动冷水冲。

shots.scene: 火势变大，人员撤离，手机上显示119
shots.prompt_en: Students walk calmly out of the room following an exit sign while one dials on a phone showing 119.
shots.narration: 火控制不住，撤离并拨打119。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，旁边三个图标：实验室、学院、保卫处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; beside her three icons: a lab door, a college building and a security shield.
shots.narration: 有人受伤打120，并逐级报告。

shots.scene: 屏幕关闭出光，手关紧气瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: A finger switches off the laser toggle on the touchscreen, then a hand closes the cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 用完先关出光，再关气瓶阀。

shots.scene: 关电源、拔钥匙，焊接头放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The power switch is turned off, the key is removed, and the welding head rests in its cradle. No people.
shots.narration: 关机拔钥匙，焊接头放回支架。

shots.scene: 阿杰清扫工位，在使用记录本上签名
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sweeps the welding area and signs a blank equipment usage logbook.
shots.narration: 清理现场，填写使用记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的焊机旁，身边浮现开箱、安装图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the tidy laser welder; icons of a box and a wrench float beside it.
shots.narration: 开箱清点，装好气、电、送丝。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现护目镜、屏障、急停图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to floating icons of laser goggles, a safety barrier and an emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 受控区里操作，防护戴齐。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现气瓶链条、灭火器、排风罩图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to icons of a chained gas cylinder, a fire extinguisher and an exhaust hood.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定，排风开好，灭火器备好。

shots.scene: 欣欣手拿钥匙和记录本
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small key and a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 维护先断电，用完要记录。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、老李在焊机旁一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student, the young male student and the facility engineer wave goodbye together beside the laser welder.
shots.narration: 安全上手，下次见！
